text.p: Nestle SA said Friday it was negotiating to buy Peru's largest ice-cream and confectionery company D'Onofrio.
"We have decided to enter the Peruvian ice-cream market next summer, therefore we are negotiating the purchase of D'Onofrio," a Nestle spokesman in Lima told Reuters.
The spokesman added that the negotiations, which began earlier this year, "are continuing and are delicate, like any negotiation of this sort."
D'Onofrio currently belongs to local group Gloria.
The spokesman said that if Nestle was not successful in its bid to buy D'Onofrio, it would import ice-creams to Peru from plants owned by its subsidiaries in Chile, Argentina and Venezuela.
